spec_theorems.name: run_one_stdout_exact
spec_theorems.informal: For exactly one pathname operand, stdout consists of exactly the model basename result as its single output line.

spec_theorems.name: run_one_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: For exactly one pathname operand, the utility reports successful completion with exit status 0.

spec_theorems.name: run_stdin_not_used
spec_theorems.informal: Standard input is not used: changing the input lines never changes the result of running the model.

spec_theorems.name: basename_chars_empty_is_empty
spec_theorems.informal: For the null string case, this implementation-defined model chooses the null string as the resulting basename.

spec_theorems.name: basename_chars_all_slashes_nonempty
spec_theorems.informal: For any nonempty pathname consisting entirely of slash characters, the resulting basename characters are a single slash.

spec_theorems.name: basename_chars_nonempty_not_all
spec_theorems.informal: For any nonempty pathname not consisting entirely of slashes, the model follows the documented steps of removing trailing slashes and then taking the component after the last remaining slash.
